object.name: evi.lorez~
object.digest: A novel two-pole nonlinear Ladder filter
object.description: Nonlinear 12dB TPT Lowpass with excellent modulation properties and allpass alignment. Capable of all audio rate modulation with cutoff FM-able whilst remaining stable. Resonance stays strong even in lower frequencies. The abstraction includes code which can be extracted for parameter rate control of the coefficients calculation and linear operation if required.
object.discussion: For more information about other nonlinear Ladder filters in evieve, see the 'evieve ladder' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.description: Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance with a little loss in anti-aliasing.
